en: A Day in a Doctor's Life

intro.uz: Bu — bolalar shifokorining blogi. Oʻqishdan oldin: shifokorlar sogʻliq uchun qanday maslahatlar beradi?

paragraphs.en: Hi, I'm Rustam. I am a doctor at a children's hospital in Samarkand. I love my job, but it is not easy.
paragraphs.uz: Salom, men Rustamman. Men Samarqanddagi bolalar kasalxonasida shifokorman. Men ishimni yaxshi koʻraman, lekin u oson emas.

paragraphs.en: I usually get up at half past five. I start work at seven. Every morning I see about twenty children. Some children have got a cold, and some have got a stomachache.
paragraphs.uz: Men odatda soat besh yarimda turaman. Ishni soat yettida boshlayman. Har kuni ertalab yigirmatacha bolani qabul qilaman. Baʼzi bolalar shamollagan, baʼzilarining esa qorni ogʻriydi.

paragraphs.en: Children are often scared of doctors. So I always smile and tell a funny joke. Then they aren't scared.
paragraphs.uz: Bolalar koʻpincha shifokorlardan qoʻrqishadi. Shuning uchun men doim jilmayaman va kulgili hazil aytaman. Shunda ular qoʻrqmaydi.

paragraphs.en: Here is my advice for you. You should wash your hands before every meal. You must sleep nine or ten hours, and you shouldn't eat too many sweets!
paragraphs.uz: Mana sizga maslahatim. Har safar ovqatdan oldin qoʻlingizni yuvishingiz kerak. Toʻqqiz-oʻn soat uxlashingiz shart, shirinliklarni esa juda koʻp yemasligingiz kerak!
